subject.title: Feature: Add costCurrency config option to customize cost display currency

question: Should configured model-cost estimates remain USD-only, or should OpenClaw define a non-USD currency contract for configured provider/model pricing and cost display?
rationale: The request crosses public config, local estimate accounting, status/reply output, Control UI summaries, USD-named persisted fields, telemetry, and the newer provider-reported billing surface, so automation should not choose the product contract.

options.title: Design one currency contract first
options.body: Choose provider/model/global scope, ISO-code validation, display-only versus accounting semantics, mixed-currency aggregation, persisted field naming, docs, and tests before implementation.

options.title: Keep configured costs USD-only
options.body: Leave `models.providers.*.models[].cost` as USD estimates and point non-USD balances/spend to provider usage reporting surfaces.

options.title: Add display-only override
options.body: Allow a narrow symbol/code override while explicitly documenting that stored totals, metrics, and telemetry remain USD-like estimates.

recommendation.title: Design one currency contract first
recommendation.body: Choose provider/model/global scope, ISO-code validation, display-only versus accounting semantics, mixed-currency aggregation, persisted field naming, docs, and tests before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: He authored the original usage-cost reporting and recent provider-billing work that this contract must coordinate with.
